visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men, one wearing a yellow safety vest and a blue cap, the other in a blue vest labeled "GARY", stand in a grey-walled apartment hallway. They knock on a glass-paned door. A woman wearing a purple strapless mini-dress opens the door, her hair tied in a neat bun. She appears surprised and joyful, gesturing towards the interior of the apartment while smiling broadly. (2) Inside the living room, the three characters are engaged in a lively conversation. The room features white walls decorated with framed calligraphy and a large flat-screen TV. The woman points to various items around the room, including stacked cardboard boxes. The hosts hold microphones with a yellow "HahaTai" logo. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (3) The hosts present the woman with a long red ceremonial sash featuring yellow text and tassels. They carefully place the sash over her shoulder. The woman laughs and poses for the camera while holding a rectangular handheld sign. The camera captures her from a medium shot, highlighting her enthusiastic facial expressions and the festive atmosphere. (4) A tan Shiba Inu dog walks into the frame from a tiled balcony area. The woman bends down to pet the dog's head and neck. The dog looks calm, with its tongue slightly out. The setting shifts briefly to a close-up of the dog's face. The background remains a domestic indoor environment with boxes and household items. (5) The scene transitions to a bedroom area. The woman stands in front of a white vanity mirror surrounded by bright light bulbs. She picks up several pieces of clothing, including a bright red dress, and displays them to the hosts. The room is filled with cosmetics, storage drawers, and personal belongings, creating a cluttered but intimate setting.
